title: 第7章 大王有肉票上门了第8章 强盗窝禁魔之地
slug: 西游反正很无聊随便打个劫呗
lines: 龟蛇二将直接来到了山寨附近，降下云端，沉声说道。
“青玄宗弟子还不快快出门相迎！”
龟将说道。
有几名强盗此时正在田间耕耘。
他们发现了两人，顿时欣喜若狂。
“大王！
有肉票上门了！”
小喽罗见龟蛇二将身穿铠甲，气度不凡，以为是附近国度的将军。
“我知道了！”
楚云瘪了瘪嘴，这个猴子果然去把青玄宗的人请来了。
龟蛇二将可是真武将军一直镇守着凡间的道统。
“抄家伙！
抓肉票！”
“哥哥，我并没有感受到有任何修仙之人的气息！”
其中一人疑惑的问道。
他们之前接到的任务是说青玄宗，有人在这里故意挡住了唐僧师徒的去路。
之前并没仔细思考。
现在回想起来，整件事情透露着一股诡异。
唐僧师徒那是什么配置？
齐天大圣，天蓬元帅，卷帘大将。
他们一个小小的青玄宗，真的可以挡住对方吗？
“等调查清楚，我们回去复命就行！”
另一人本着公事公办的态度。
不多时已经有四五十名强盗，然后他们围了起来。
为首之人是一个年轻人。
“大王，今天算是发财了，他们身上铠甲，拿出去卖少说也能卖几十两银子！”
一名小喽啰谄媚的说道。
楚云不由翻了翻白眼。
没见识真可怕。
这两人作为真武将军，在凡间的跟班。
身上的铠甲怎么可能是凡品？
他的手下还想将其几十两卖掉。
“你们谁是青玄宗之人？”
之前天蓬元帅前往青玄宗说，他们宗门中有人在这里为非作歹。
真武将军才派他们两人前来调查。
“他说什么宗？”
“大王，我不知道，是不是草台班子？”
楚云身旁的这些小喽啰都是草包，哪里听说过青玄宗。
“原来是草台班子唱大戏的，既然你们来到这里，就不能坏了我们这里的规矩。”
楚云上前一步嚣张的说道。
“把你们身上值钱的东西拿出来，然后留下这身铠甲，我可以放你们活着离开！”
content_en:
The two generals Turtle and Snake came directly to the village, lowered the clouds, and said in a deep voice.
"Qingxuanzong disciples, hurry up and go out to greet us!"
Turtle General said.
Several bandits were plowing in the fields at this time.
They spotted the two and were immediately overjoyed.
"King!
Meat tickets are coming! "
The young man saw that the two generals, Turtle and Snake, were wearing armor and looked extraordinary, so they thought they were generals from a nearby country.
"I know!"
Chu Yun pursed his lips. As expected, the monkey went to invite the people from Qingxuan Sect.
The two generals, Turtle and Snake, are Zhenwu generals who have always guarded the orthodoxy of the mortal world.
“Copy guy!
Grab the meat ticket! "
…………
"Brother, I don't feel the aura of anyone cultivating immortality!"
One of them asked doubtfully.
The task they received before was to talk about Qingxuan Sect. Someone deliberately blocked the path of Tang Seng and his disciples here.
I didn't think about it carefully before.
Looking back now, the whole thing seems weird.
What is the configuration of Tang Seng and his disciples?
The Great Sage Qitian, Marshal Tianpeng, and General Rolling Curtain.
Can their little Qingxuan Sect really block the opponent?
"When the investigation is clear, we can just go back and resume our lives!"
The other person had a business-like attitude.
"Okay!"
Not long after, there were forty or fifty bandits, and then they surrounded him.
The leader is a young man.
"Your Majesty, I have made a fortune today. The armor they are wearing can be sold for dozens of taels of silver at least!"
One of the minions said flatteringly.
Chu Yun couldn't help but rolled his eyes.
It's terrible to be ignorant.
These two people serve as the true warrior generals and their followers in the mortal world.
How could the armor on his body be of ordinary quality?
His men also wanted to sell dozens of taels of it.
"Which one of you is from Qingxuan Sect?"
Marshal Tianpeng went to Qingxuan Sect before and said that someone in their sect was doing evil here.
General Zhenwu sent the two of them to investigate.
"What religion did he speak of?"
"Your Majesty, I don't know, are you from the Caotai team?"
These little minions around Chu Yun are all idiots. They have never heard of Qingxuan Sect.
"It turns out it's the Caotai Troupe who sings the big show. Now that you're here, you can't break our rules here."
Chu Yun took a step forward and said arrogantly.
"Take out the valuable things you have on you, and leave this armor. I can let you leave alive!"
title_en: Chapter 7 The King has meat tickets. Chapter 8 The robber's den and the place where demons are forbidden.
